name: features-section-demo-1

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows all eight cards evenly lit with titles and copy fully readable.

tagline: A four-column grid of dark feature cards, each with a title and short copy.
summary: Lays out eight feature cards in a responsive grid that steps from one to four columns. Each card has a soft dark gradient, a faint grid pattern, a bold title and a short grey description.
appearance: A two-row, four-column grid of rounded cards on a near-black page. Each card fades from dark grey at the top to black at the bottom, carries a faint square grid pattern near its top, and sets a bold white title above small grey body text.
behaviour: Static: the cards hold still and nothing responds to pointer, hover or scroll. Only a faint patterned square sits behind each title.
demo_content: Eight cards: HIPAA and SOC2 Compliant, Automated Social Media Posting, Advanced Analytics and more.
use_when: A page needs to list several capabilities compactly in a responsive grid of text cards.
avoid_when: The copy is fixed in an internal array and the cards carry no icons, imagery or interaction.
customise: The default section exposes nothing; the eight titles and descriptions sit in a local array, and pattern squares are generated in the source.
weight_why: Eight static cards with CSS gradients and one small SVG pattern each.

a11y.note: Decorative SVG is hidden from assistive tech and the text is real, but titles are styled paragraphs rather than headings.

issues: The cards show no icons or images, only text on a faint grid.
Titles and copy are fixed in an internal array, so changes mean editing the file.
The grid pattern is so faint it barely registers.
polish_why: Even spacing and a restrained gradient; the cards are plain text blocks with barely visible pattern.
